# neptune

Neptune gremlin/openCypher/SPARQL access - bounded traversals only - plus cluster encryption posture from dumps.

## Recipes

- `apiforge model neptune --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge model neptune-access --path <dump-or-project>`
- `apiforge knowledge show neptune`
- `apiforge judge` then filter findings by rules AF-DATA-013, AF-STORE-004
